n2e4d842e2c.headline: Shares are punished again as Donald Trump ups the ante against Kim
n2e4d842e2c.summary: Shares declined and the Wall Street fear gauge hit a nine-month high as U.S. President Donald Trump increased rhetoric against North Korea.
n2e4d842e2c.why: Geopolitical tensions can increase market volatility and risk aversion, impacting equity markets and investor sentiment globally.
n2e4d842e2c.why_moved: Escalation in geopolitical tensions raised investor risk aversion, causing share prices to fall and volatility to rise.

n7f75cc9dc3.headline: Hasanoğlu Construction to make joint investment with Saudi Group
n7f75cc9dc3.summary: Turkish construction firm Hasanoğlu Construction will partner with Saudi Arabian real estate investor Alasiri Group for a joint investment.
n7f75cc9dc3.why: Cross-border investments in construction and real estate reflect growing regional economic cooperation and capital flows.
